intended_guard_correction: Path.is_file is already a regular-file check, so nested nonregular rejection was unreachable for FIFO/socket/device entries. Now directories skip explicitly and all other nonregular entries reject before read.
native_platform_limit: Windows here lacks socket.AF_UNIX and os.mkfifo. Four kind controls use explicit synthetic filesystem stat results; actual regular directory/file hashing runs. Real POSIX FIFO test is present and skipped here.
